head: murmur daily sends three short messages a day matched to your mood
dek: Each morning you tell murmur how you feel in one word, and it sends three short messages for that feeling: morning, midday and evening. It was #3 among paid Lifestyle apps on the US App Store on 10 November.
details: There are no feeds, streaks or ads; you can save messages and share them as cards. It costs $2.99, and full access needs a $2.99-a-month subscription. By Reuben Holmes; needs iOS 15.1.
means: If you want a few calm words through the day instead of another feed, this is that.
todo: Find murmur daily in the App Store; note the subscription before you buy.
